mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_cards ( user_card_id, user_id, card_id, codef_account_credential_id, card_name_from_codef, card_no, card_number_enc, card_password_enc, issuer_id, display_order, is_active, codef_card_key_hash, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userCardId}, #{userId}, #{cardId}, #{linkId}, #{cardNameFromCodef}, #{cardNo}, #{cardNumberEnc}, #{cardPasswordEnc}, #{issuerId}, #{displayOrder}, #{isActive}, #{codefCardKeyHash}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) )
mapper.select: SELECT uc.user_card_id, uc.card_id, i.requires_card_no, i.requires_card_password, (uc.card_number_enc IS NOT NULL) AS has_card_number, (uc.card_password_enc IS NOT NULL) AS has_card_password FROM user_cards uc INNER JOIN issuers i ON i.issuer_id = uc.issuer_id WHERE uc.codef_account_credential_id = #{linkId} AND uc.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY uc.display_order ASC, uc.user_card_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_card_option_selections ( user_card_id, option_group_id, card_id, option_choice_id, selected_at ) VALUES ( #{userCardId}, #{optionGroupId}, #{cardId}, #{optionChoiceId}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE card_id = VALUES(card_id), option_choice_id = VALUES(option_choice_id), selected_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)
mapper.select: SELECT uc.user_card_id, uc.codef_account_credential_id, c.connected_id, i.institution_code, c.birth_date_enc, i.requires_card_no, i.requires_card_password, uc.card_id, uc.card_no, i.issuer_name FROM user_cards uc INNER JOIN codef_account_credentials c ON c.codef_account_credential_id = uc.codef_account_credential_id INNER JOIN issuers i ON i.issuer_id = uc.issuer_id WHERE uc.user_card_id = #{userCardId} AND uc.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT user_card_id, card_number_enc, card_password_enc FROM user_cards WHERE codef_account_credential_id = #{linkId} AND card_number_enc IS NOT NULL ORDER BY display_order ASC, user_card_id ASC LIMIT 1
